Group of [[Aes Sedai]], [[Kinswomen]], [[Windfinders]] and [[Wise Ones]] that traveled to the [[farm]] of [[the Kin]], near [[Ebou Dar]]. There some of them used the [[Bowl of the Winds]] and fought the [[Seanchan]]. They were more than 170 female [[channeler]]s and in front of the Seanchan invasion, all of them [[travel]]ed to [[Andor]] led by [[Elayne]].
